players.product: Chromium single-cell and Atera spatial biology platforms

quarterly_data.signal: CEO: the company envisions a significant opportunity to extend its technologies into clinical diagnostics, which requires generating robust clinical evidence on large patient cohorts; it is continuing to make progress on its internal efforts to generate such evidence in oncology and in autoimmunity. This quarter it announced new partnerships with the Cleveland Clinic and with the Lausanne University Hospital to identify biomarkers of response to therapy across multiple oncology indications.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: clinical research partners (oncology biomarkers of response to therapy)
